review.pixelCoordinateConvention: Pixel coordinates are measured in a crop whose top-left corner is the EPSG extent northwest corner; pixel coordinates convert with the0.25m crop grid without a hand registration.
review.horizontalAccuracyStatement: The0.25m export pixel spacing is not absolute positional accuracy. Source accuracy is unpublished here; boundary uncertainty is a manual interpretation estimate, not survey certification.
